LanguageData.RL_LavaDeep.label: 深熔岩

LanguageData.RL_LavaShallow.label: 浅熔岩

LanguageData.RL_CooledLava.label: 冷却熔岩岩岸
LanguageData.RL_CooledLava.description: 深部熔岩周围已经凝固的岩岸。
